title: Reef Wrecks
description: The Bahamas is the underwater movie capital of the world. For decades, Hollywood has come here to make epic movies and TV shows in its crystal waters.

title: Animals Like Us
description: A fish cleans a shark's pearly white teeth, two giraffes have a cuddle and a monkey shows off his toolbox.

title: Baboons: Rules of the Troop
description: Cameras follow four different species of baboons who have conquered African deserts, coasts, savannah and mountains, adapting to the challenges of their environment along the way.

title: Great Lakes Wild
description: The push to increase the population numbers of Ontario's eight turtle species, seven of which are listed as endangered. But turtles are slow and not entirely smart.

title: Great Lakes Wild
description: A dam is an engineering feat that controls massive amounts of water. But as this episode shows, it can also wreak havoc on the animals that call those waters home.

title: Planet Weird
description: Meeting nature's oddballs and mavericks, revealing the bizarre behaviours and ingenious adaptations that help remarkable animals survive.

title: Big Cats, Nine Lives
description: Following leopards through harsh landscapes, where stealth and cunning help them outwit rivals, find food and protect their young against the odds.

title: Valley of Flood and Fire
description: Documentary following the Luangwa Valley's transition from lush paradise to parched desert. It's the end of November and the rains have begun, ending a brutal dry season and beginning the transition to luscious wetland.

title: Valley of Flood and Fire
description: As the dry season takes hold in Luangwa Valley, lagoons dry up and verdant grasslands gradually turn to dust. Animals must take advantage while they can.

title: Valley of Flood and Fire
description: The documentary about the Luangwa Valley considers how the life of every animal is linked to the vastly different seasons - the wet and the dry.

title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
description: The broadcaster explores the ways different creatures hear and produce sound and how it can influence their decisions, using cutting-edge audio technology to reveal a new perspective and understanding of animal behaviour.

title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
description: From melodic songs to strange hums, David Attenborough shares the sounds that gibbons, lyrebirds, bull elk and more use to find a mate - and warn off the competition.

title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
description: A look at how baby animals communicate in their quest for survival, using sound to beg and call for help in the early days of life.

title: Deadly Australians
description: In the depths of Australia's oceans lurks a killer crew of creatures. Discover the deadliest of them all.

title: Shark Squad
description: The mako, a relatively unstudied shark species, which has the advantages of a quick-thinking brain and astounding speed.

title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill
description: Part one of two. Biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill sets out on a mission to protect one of Earth's most elusive creatures - the snow leopard.

title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill
description: Part two of two. Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for the largest snow leopard ever recorded, known as 'the Dude'.

title: Uptown Otters
description: Mia and her newborn pups go swimming, before welcoming in an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a park's main attraction.

title: My Best Friend's an Animal
description: Animals that have unlikely friendships with humans, beginning with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub.

title: Extraordinary Animals
description: Delve into the surprising behaviours of some of Australia's most unlikely romantics, including shingleback lizards, eastern ospreys, brown boobys and even corals.

title: Extraordinary Animals
description: Meeting some uniquely curious animals, including brushtail possums, parrots, numbats and more.

title: City Wildlife Rescue
description: A flock of cedar waxwings takes over the centre's aviary and keeps the staff busy with endless demands for food.

title: City Wildlife Rescue
description: The rescue team undertakes a madcap chase after a red-tailed hawk - he can't fly, but he can certainly run. Plus, rare albino squirrel recovers from being unwell.

title: New Kids in the Wild
description: Sea lion Lola takes her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentina's coast.

title: Bears of the Karawank Mountains
description: Documentary following a young male brown bear on his adventures in a mountain range that forms a natural border between Slovenia and Austria.

title: Slovenia: Where Nature Comes First
description: The natural wonders of Slovenia, from Mediterranean olive groves to snow-capped peaks, as well as wildlife such as brown bears and the world's largest trout.

title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
description: Following polar bears hunting for seals, macaques bathing in natural hot springs, and Arctic foxes trying out a unique survival strategy.

title: Flying Monsters with David Attenborough
description: The broadcaster explores the world of the pterosaur, a flying creature that occupied the skies 200 million years ago. Visiting sites around the world, from the Dorset coast to New Mexico, he explains how the reptiles evolved to defy the forces of gravity, and examines the features of their anatomy that can still be seen in present-day descendents. He also discovers why they became extinct after dominating the skies for millions of years.

title: David Attenborough's Natural History Museum Alive
description: The broadcaster invites viewers to join him as he takes an after-hours stroll around one of his favourite places, the Natural History Museum. But this is no ordinary tour as some of the many exhibits spring to life as the veteran naturalist strolls along.

title: Planet Weird
description: A look at some of the Earth's harshest environments, where creatures battle the elements to survive.

title: Macaque Island
description: Exploring the lives of two troops of long-tailed macaques residing in the forests of Singapore, revealing the fascinating world of these curious and intelligent primates. Matnoor rules over the 30 members of the Street troop, wihile Aarav is the old alpha male of the wilder Hill troop.

title: Macaque Island
description: The Hill Troop invade the Street Troop's turf, before the Sisterhood plots to kidnap Sara's baby. Meanwhile, alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back.
